guard: cotal_connection_status reports MeshAgent's live state through the registered MCP route
why: The mutation changes the status source itself to a constant. The named cell reaches the tool through a real MCP client and stages the source true, so it can only stay green if the route reports that source rather than assuming a value.

The full predicted kill set is recorded in the suite header before the run. Every other cell is OUT for a stated reason, including schema closure, refusal, buffered counts, drain measurement, and the degraded case whose staged connected value already matches the mutant.
The suite imports connector-core source relatively, so mutation-proof executes the changed source directly and needs no build or afterRestore command.

mutations.name: MeshAgent connected state is replaced by a constant false
mutations.expectRed: the real MCP route reports the MeshAgent's live connected=true state
mutations.cell: the real MCP route reports the MeshAgent's live connected=true state
mutations.note: This proves the tool reports the live MeshAgent getter. It deliberately does not mutate the tool's renderer, which could only prove formatting while leaving the state source ungraded.
